description: A repository holding a backend and a frontend in separate directories, each resolved by its own profile.
architecture: Each area keeps its own build system, conventions, and quality gates.
The API contract is the boundary; a change to it affects both areas and needs integration review.
A change confined to one area is ordinary single-area work and needs no coordination.
Determining affected areas precedes deciding which roles are involved.
limitations: Supplies no commands. A composed project must declare commands that cover both areas explicitly.
Area directories are fixed by this definition. A repository laid out differently needs its own profile.
project.build_system cannot be used with a composed profile, because there is more than one build root.
Composition is one level deep; an area profile must itself declare build systems.
Determining affected areas is path analysis only. It does not prove that an area is unaffected in behavior.
Multi-repository composition remains unsupported and is rejected by the project schema.
